title: Admit a pinned Cargo PackToolLaunch for Windows packaging
description: SPIDR interface leaf split from task-bed2e4d570a14e21a26092d6377dfd44 after reachability measurement showed that changing the closed PackToolLaunch kind roster plus the shared moe-toolchain-pins/1 shape would exceed the parent’s exact seven-path rail and collide with unrelated release readers. Objective: land a dedicated, exact-key Cargo 1.96.0 pin/admission seam. Deliverable: new cargo-toolchain-pins.ts/json and pack-cargo-tool.ts/test.ts capture one canonical external kind:"cargo" PackToolLaunch with exact byte/version identity; pack-tool-identity.ts adds only the cargo discriminant, while its four existing production type consumers remain source-compatible and typechecked. Not in scope: no WindowsPackToolchain manifest, sanitized PATH, materialized-child, broker build, or release artifact change; consumer task-bed2e4d570a14e21a26092d6377dfd44 must declare this row in dependsOn before composition. Exact verification command: pnpm exec vitest run tools/packaging/pack-cargo-tool.test.ts (must print nonzero Test Files and Tests counts); also run pnpm typecheck:packaging standalone.
definitionOfDone: A dedicated tracked cargo-toolchain-pins/1 exact-key document pins Cargo 1.96.0, its Windows x64 toolchain identity and executable SHA-256 without changing the existing moe-toolchain-pins/1 schema; missing, extra, malformed, or unsupported pin documents refuse with code PACK_STEP_FAILED at layer PACKAGING_TOOLCHAIN.

The production Cargo admission function accepts only an explicit absolute canonical executable outside the repository, proves regular/non-symlink bytes, exact pinned digest and exact `cargo 1.96.0` stdout using argv plus shell:false, and returns a deeply frozen kind:"cargo" PackToolLaunch without consulting PATH, USERPROFILE, CARGO_HOME, or shell command strings.

Focused production-surface tests cover valid admission plus missing, extra, malformed, missing-file, in-repository, symlink, wrong-version, wrong-digest and post-capture substitution cases; every refusal asserts PACK_STEP_FAILED and PACKAGING_TOOLCHAIN, generated cases assert a nonzero denominator, and loosening the named digest guard makes its divergence assertion red.

A test passes the admitted Cargo launch through production leaseEntriesForTool and assertPackToolIdentity, proving the generic lease/identity consumers cover the new discriminant while pack-command, pack-windows-archive, pack-windows-candidate and pack-windows-process-lease remain source-compatible.

All nine affected paths stay within production-file caps; `pnpm exec vitest run tools/packaging/pack-cargo-tool.test.ts` prints nonzero Test Files/Tests counts and exits 0, and `pnpm typecheck:packaging` exits 0 in standalone foreground runs.
